name: Arbium
description: Arbium connects Claude to the user's work memory: documents, people, applications, decisions, and the steps behind completed work. Claude can search atomic facts, activity episodes, longer-running threads, entities, source captures, and recurring workflows; inspect supporting context; and use that lived history to answer questions or continue work in the user's established way. Access is OAuth-based and responses are scoped to the authenticated user.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Arbium to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Arbium to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.arbium.ai/api/ask-mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Arbium MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Arbium lists 14 MCP tools, including aggregate_activity, discover_workflows, find_entities, find_workflow_instances, get_capture_tree, get_captures, get_entity, get_episode, get_profile, get_thread, search_captures, and search_episodes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Arbium?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Arbium in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Arbium requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Arbium is developed by Arbium, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
